title_en: Conversion is not a resistive voltage drop
title_zh: 转换不等于用电阻消耗压差
question_en: Does stepping 100 V down to 12 V waste 88% of the power?
question_zh: 100 V降至12 V，是否必然浪费88%的功率？
answer_en: No. An ideal 12 V, 1 A output draws only 0.12 A average from a 100 V source. Input current is pulsed; the inductor current can remain continuous.
answer_zh: 不必然。理想12 V、1 A输出仅从100 V输入取0.12 A平均电流。输入电流为脉冲，电感电流可以连续。
equation: Pin = Pout (ideal); Iin,avg = Vout Iout / Vin
basis_en: Power conservation and the stated ideal assumptions.
basis_zh: 能量守恒及所列理想假设。

question_en: Where does positive inductor current flow when both MOSFETs are OFF?
question_zh: 两个MOSFET均关断时，正向电感电流流向哪里？
answer_en: In this buck state, it flows from ground through the low-side body diode to SW and through the inductor. The assumed 0.8 V diode drop makes SW = -0.8 V.
answer_zh: 在此降压工作状态中，电流从地经低侧体二极管到SW，再经电感续流。假设二极管压降0.8 V，因此SW为-0.8 V。
equation: vL = L diL/dt; VSW = -VF during positive-current diode freewheel
basis_en: TI SLPA009A section 3.3; P02 ideal positive-CCM assumptions.
basis_zh: TI SLPA009A第3.3节；P02理想正向CCM假设。

title_en: Capacitor charging is a current balance
title_zh: 电容是否充电取决于电流平衡
question_en: Can Cout charge after the high-side switch turns OFF?
question_zh: 高侧关断以后，Cout还会充电吗？
answer_en: Yes, if iL exceeds the load current. At iL = 1.2 A and Iload = 1 A, iC = +0.2 A. The GIF shows this KCL current but holds Vout fixed; it does not solve ripple.
answer_zh: 会，只要电感电流大于负载电流。iL=1.2 A、Iload=1 A时，iC=+0.2 A。GIF显示该KCL电流，但固定Vout，不求解纹波。
equation: iC = iL - Iload; iC = C dVout/dt
basis_en: Kirchhoff current law and capacitor constitutive relation.
basis_zh: 基尔霍夫电流定律与电容本构关系。

title_en: Local gate voltage and absolute gate voltage differ
title_zh: 局部栅源电压不同于栅极对地电压
question_en: The gate is at 110 V and the source at 100 V. What is VGS?
question_zh: 栅极110 V、源极100 V，VGS是多少？
answer_en: VGS is 10 V. A high-side driver floats with SW. Gate-oxide and drain-source voltage limits must be checked separately.
answer_zh: VGS为10 V。高侧驱动跟随SW浮动；栅氧与漏源电压限制须分别检查。
basis_en: TI floating/bootstrap gate-driver technical references; 10 V is an illustration assumption.
basis_zh: TI浮动/自举驱动技术资料；10 V为演示假设。

title_en: A bootstrap supply has a charge budget
title_zh: 自举供电需要核算电荷
question_en: Is a bootstrap capacitor automatically recharged every cycle?
question_zh: 每个周期自举电容都会自动充满吗？
answer_en: No. Available low-SW time, charging impedance, gate charge, leakage and driver UVLO matter. P03 checks the assumed charge/recharge sequence.
answer_zh: 不会。SW低电位时间、充电阻抗、栅电荷、漏电和驱动UVLO都会影响结果。P03核对假设条件下的放电/补充电荷过程。
equation: Delta Vboot approximately (Qg + Iq ton + Qleak) / Cboot
basis_en: TI SLUA887A section 3.1, charge sizing and UVLO margin.
basis_zh: TI SLUA887A第3.1节，自举电荷选取与UVLO裕量。

title_en: Small delays matter at high input voltage
title_zh: 高输入电压下，短延迟也很重要
question_en: How much can current rise in 100 ns with 88 V across 100 uH?
question_zh: 100 uH电感承受88 V，100 ns内电流增加多少？
answer_en: 0.088 A. This hand estimate explains why current-sense filtering, comparator delay and gate turn-off affect overshoot. It is not a complete protection calculation.
answer_zh: 增加0.088 A。这个手算说明了检测滤波、比较器延迟与栅关断为何影响过冲；它不是完整保护计算。
equation: Delta I = VL Delta t / L
basis_en: Inductor law with explicitly assumed voltage, time and inductance.
basis_zh: 电感定律及明确假设的电压、时间和电感值。

title_en: Do not count switching energy twice
title_zh: 开关能量不能重复计算
question_en: Can overlap, Coss and reverse-recovery energy always be added independently?
question_zh: 交叠、Coss与反向恢复能量能否无条件分别相加？
answer_en: Only if the current terms are defined without overlap. An integral of VDS times total drain current may already contain capacitive and recovery components. Read P08's accounting assumptions.
answer_zh: 只有电流分项互不重复时才可以。VDS与总漏极电流乘积的积分可能已含电容及恢复分量；应先阅读P08的核算假设。
equation: E = integral v i dt; Eoss = integral v Coss(v) dv
basis_en: Circuit energy definition plus the documented separation of switching mechanisms.
basis_zh: 电路能量定义与记录在案的开关机理划分。

title_en: A tested model still needs physical evidence
title_zh: 通过测试的模型仍需要物理证据
question_en: Does passing a simulation test prove a transistor is safe at 150 V input?
question_zh: 仿真测试通过，能否证明晶体管适用于150 V输入？
answer_en: No. The tests check stated equations, conservation and numerical implementation. PDK corners, calibrated parasitics, measured devices, isolation and SOA are additional requirements.
answer_zh: 不能。测试检查所列方程、守恒及数值实现；PDK工艺角、校准寄生、实测器件、隔离和SOA还需要额外证据。
equation: Numerical consistency is different from calibrated physical accuracy
basis_en: Explicit model scope and validation boundaries in this release.
basis_zh: 本版明确列出的模型范围与验证边界。
